note: Family-run RV park on US-30 at the west edge of North Platte, beside the Union Pacific Bailey Yard (train noise). Dirt pull-throughs around stocked private fishing ponds (no license needed) with a small sand beach; the pond-side sites are rented by the month. On-site propane, ATM and the Last Chance Bar & Grill. Mixes overnight travelers with seasonal and long-term residents. --Claude
summary: Operator moved to lincolnhighwayrv.com (old Wix domain dead). Nightly $40 + tax (fees added), phone reservations, full hookups 30/50 A, pull-throughs, year-round, all confirmed manual. RV Life 7.78/10 (36) is under the 8.0 gate: drop candidate. Waterfront lakefront -> not waterfront (ponds 4.2 acres; waterfront sites are monthly only).
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (private gate): RV Life average 7.78/10 from 36 reviews is under the 8.0 line. Google is 4.4 from 211 (passes). Long-stay signals: weekly $175 / monthly $350 rates on the operator page ('Stay a night or stay the season', 'long-term sites — every month of the year'); RV Life reviews 7/2026 'a mixture or short and long term residents' and 'a lot of junky rvs and everything is dirt ground'. It does sell nights to transients ($40 + tax, four of the five newest reviews were overnight stays, $30-40). Price passes the $50 gate.
WEBSITE: stored https://www.lincolnhighwayrvpark.com/ is dead (Wix ConnectYourDomain 404). The operator's live site is https://lincolnhighwayrv.com/ (same phone, owners named, (c) 2026). Replace it.

WATERFRONT lakefront -> not waterfront: the park's own water is a chain of ponds; OSM maps the central one at 4.19 acres (under the ~5-acre pond line) and the south and east ponds are smaller. The 28.9-acre lake west of the park lies beyond the park's west track and a tree row, with only boxy long-term trailers between. The operator says 'Sites right on the water' are a monthly-only rate; the nightly pull-throughs are the dirt rows east of the office, 150+ m from any pond. Imagery 2026-11-05.
SAND RULE: not applicable (sand beach is a pond-side sitting area, no driving).
PIN OK: stored 41.157,-100.8165 is on the east pull-through rows; Google 41.15740,-100.81781 (office) is ~115 m west.
NOTE: operator does not state a site count or rig limit; the old note's 'three small private lakes ... swimming and non-motorized boats' and '$30 nightly' are not on the current site (rate is $40).
